_comment: Three Forever trees (Wowhead per task statement). status modelled -> effect read by the engine; unmodelled -> reason. Row r needs 5*r points in the same tree before the pick.

talents.name: Improved Life Tap
talents.source: Classic: +10%/rank mana from Life Tap; Forever scaling unconfirmed

talents.name: Suppression
talents.source: Classic: -2% miss per rank on Affliction spells; task asks to check whether it applies to Shadow Bolt/Searing Pain (assumed no)

talents.name: Improved Corruption
talents.source: Task: Corruption instant at 5/5, +10% damage; Classic -0.4 s per rank

talents.name: Grim Reach
talents.source: Range talent

talents.name: Soul Harvest
talents.source: Task: kill under Drain Soul: +100% mana regen for 10 s, regen 100% while casting (rank 1 assumed half)

talents.name: Improved Drains
talents.source: Task: +20% drains at 3/3

talents.name: Improved Bane of Agony
talents.source: Classic Improved Curse of Agony analogue; Forever value unknown

talents.name: Fel Concentration
talents.source: Classic-like chance to avoid pushback while channeling; value unconfirmed

talents.name: Amplify Curse
talents.reason: 3 minute cooldown, empowers one curse/bane per 3 minutes; ignored in short pulls
talents.source: Task

talents.name: Pandemic
talents.source: Task: bigger crit damage of DoTs and drains; +0.1 crit multiplier per rank assumed

talents.name: Malevolence
talents.source: Effect not given in the task; assumed +1% crit on Affliction spells per rank (param)

talents.name: Nightfall
talents.source: Task: chance for a free instant Shadow Bolt; Classic 2%/rank per Corruption or Drain Life tick

talents.name: Curse of Exhaustion
talents.reason: movement slow; no effect on the model
talents.source: Task
